name: Kubernetes-native clinical MCP federation
tagline: Clinical AI agent platform that federates several MCP servers behind one endpoint to query MIMIC-IV securely.
problem: IDEs and AI clients need governed access to sensitive clinical research data across many tools.
solution: Federates multiple MCP servers into a single endpoint on Kubernetes, with agents, tools and service discovery mediating access to the MIMIC-IV dataset.
